question: At the Doha Diamond League 2025, after throwing beyond 90 metres, Neeraj Chopra achieved which historic distinction for Indian athletics?

options.text: He broke the world record for the longest javelin throw.
He became the 1st Indian athlete to surpass the 90-metre mark in javelin throw.
He became the 3rd Indian athlete to surpass the 90-metre mark in javelin throw.
He became the 2nd Indian athlete to surpass the 90-metre mark in javelin throw.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He became the 1st Indian athlete to surpass the 90-metre mark in javelin throw.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**, an Indian javelin thrower, achieved a historic milestone by surpassing the **90-metre mark** at the **Doha Diamond League 2025**, a feat no other Indian athlete has accomplished before.
 
• This achievement cements Neeraj’s status as one of the greatest Indian athletes, showcasing his consistent excellence in international competitions.
 
• The **90-metre mark** in javelin throw is considered a benchmark of elite performance, and achieving this places Neeraj among the world's best javelin throwers.
 
• He already held the distinction of being **India's first Olympic gold medalist in athletics**, which he won at the **Tokyo Olympics 2021**.
 
• Neeraj’s throw in Doha adds another layer of prestige to his career, propelling Indian athletics to new heights on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Significance of Neeraj Chopra:**

 
 
• Neeraj became the **first Indian track-and-field athlete** to win a gold medal in the **Olympics** during the Tokyo 2021 Olympics, with a throw of 87.58 metres.
 
• He has also won medals in other international competitions, such as the **Asian Games** and the **Commonwealth Games**.
 
• He is a recipient of prestigious awards like the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** and the **Arjuna Award**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the 90-Metre Mark in Javelin Throw:**
 
 
• The **90-metre mark** is regarded as the gold standard in javelin throw, achieved only by a select few elite athletes globally.
 
• Throwing beyond this mark requires a perfect combination of **technique, strength, and precision**.
 
• It is a benchmark for athletes aiming for world championships and Olympic medals.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra’s Global Competitors:**
 
 
• Other world-class javelin throwers, such as **Johannes Vetter** (Germany), are known for their consistent performances beyond 90 metres.
 
• Neeraj’s achievement brings him closer to competing at the same level as these global legends.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj’s Contribution to Indian Athletics:**
 
 
• He has inspired a new generation of Indian athletes to aim for excellence in global competitions.
 
• His success has brought increased attention and investment into **Indian track-and-field sports**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Indian Javelin Throwers:**

 
 
• While Neeraj is the first to cross the 90-metre mark, athletes like **Shivpal Singh** and **Annu Rani** have also represented India in international javelin events.
 
• They have contributed to the rising prominence of javelin throw in Indian athletics.
 
 
 
• **Global Achievements in Javelin:**
 
 
• The current world record in men’s javelin throw is held by **Jan Železný** of the Czech Republic, with a throw of **98.48 metres** (achieved in 1996).
 
• In women’s javelin throw, the record is held by **Barbora Špotáková**, also from the Czech Republic, with a throw of **72.28 metres**.
